title: Falls back to security-auth-* local login when zeroTrustGate is absent
asA: shelf consumer applying application-admin-console v1.1.0 WITHOUT zeroTrustGate in the applied capability set
iWant: the sign-in surface to render as the local security-auth-* surface with no Access-gated region
soThat: the v1.1.0 admin-console remains backward-compatible with every v1.0.0 deployment that never adopted Access

acceptanceCriteria.description: When application-admin-console v1.1.0 is applied without zeroTrustGate in appliedCapabilities, GET /admin/sign-in renders a region with [data-surface=local-login] and no [data-surface=access-gated] region is present. The local login form ships with data-role=local-login-form and data-action=local-sign-in controls.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the extended admin-console pack fixture on ?caps=principalDirectory,roleModel,auditLog

acceptanceCriteria.description: The local-login surface renders exactly the security-auth-* local form contract from v1.0.0: an id-labelled input for the credential, a submit control routed to the local sign-in POST and no [data-surface=access-gated] region on the same render.
acceptanceCriteria.then: the DOM carries an input, a submit control routed to the local sign-in POST and no [data-surface=access-gated] region
